description: Olympic transportation plan truck routes is a dataset listed in City of Vancouver Open Data Portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by City of Vancouver. This dataset contains the truck routes as part of the 2010 Olympic Transportation Plan. Data access This dataset has not yet been converted to a format compatible with our new platform. Coverage: Vancouver. The portal files it under Streets and transportation. Its keywords are 2010 Winter Games. The portal shows 2016-02-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Vancouver (https://opendata.vancouver.ca/pages/licence/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-vancouver-ca-portal.
